dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Me? Sobolev. I’m the engineering supervisor here. Anything related to ice mining becomes my headache. Though "supervisor" might be giving me too much credit. I'm really just a slightly higher-ranking laborer...

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Judging by the way you're dressed, you must be a traveler from out of town. If you need help, you can ask Nekrasov in town. Handling visitors and answering questions is his job.

dialogues.speaker: Sobolev
dialogues.text: Heh, though I doubt there's much that fellow will actually help you with. If you run into real trouble, you'll have to fend for yourself...
